verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. Both put the quote text low, leaving a large empty gap under the quote mark, and the attribution sits close to the bottom edge. The logo has moved off the left column into the purple circle under the product, so it reads as product decoration rather than branding. In A the attribution is set larger, wider than the quote block, and competes with the quote. B's attribution is slightly smaller and more subordinate, so B edges ahead.
